description: Global Trade Nowcast: freight by mode (rail, road, air, land border: y/y lanes for the US, Canada, Mexico, Germany) and weekly seaborne trade volumes (tonnes moved by sea, from IMF PortWatch satellite ship tracking) for the world, the euro area and covered economies: exports, imports and net trade, 4-week and 13-week y/y, latest month y/y, split by cargo class (tanker, container, dry bulk, general cargo, ro-ro) with the goods and sectors each carries. Omit economy for a summary of all; give one for its weekly history.

economy.description: Economy code (e.g. us, cn, de), 'euro-area' or 'world'; omit for all

weeks.description: Weeks of 4-week y/y history to return (latest last)

name: get_trade
